scripts.title: Teleport FREE
scripts.features:
TeleportFREE — универсальный клиентский скрипт меток и телепорта для любой игры Roblox.

ФУНКЦИИ
• Постановка меток взглядом (raycast) или под собой
• Список меток: выбор, телепорт и удаление по каждой
• Телепорт к выбранной или к последней метке
• Настраиваемые клавиши (меню, метка, TP, удаление)
• Неоновый столб + сфера + кольцо + луч к игроку
• Имя на Billboard, дистанция в studs, rainbow и пульсация
• Плавный телепорт + смещение по Y
• Лимит меток, автовыбор новой метки
• Режим Parent = Camera (удобнее в играх с защитой)
• Анимированный экран загрузки
• Современное GUI с вкладками: Marks | Settings | Binds

КЛАВИШИ ПО УМОЛЧАНИЮ
• RightShift — открыть / закрыть меню
• G — поставить метку (по взгляду)
• T — телепорт к выбранной
• Y — телепорт к последней
• X — удалить последнюю метку

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

function notifyPlayer(title, text)
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = title;
            Text = text;
            Duration = 5;
        })
    end)
end

local fake_transparency = 1
local Motors = {
	["Left Hip"] = 0,
	["Neck"] = 0,
	["Left Shoulder"] = 0,
	["Right Hip"] = 0,
	["Right Shoulder"] = 0
}
local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")

local function getnext(tbl, number)
	local closestDiff = math.huge
	local closestValue = 0
	for i, v in pairs(tbl) do
		if i > number and i - number < closestDiff then
			closestDiff = i - number
			closestValue = i
		end
	end
	return closestValue
end

local function kftotbl(kf)
	local tbl3 = {}
	for _, v in pairs(kf:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("Pose") then
			tbl3[string.sub(v.Name, 1, 1) .. string.sub(v.Name, #v.Name, #v.Name)] = v.CFrame
		end
	end
	return tbl3
end

local function getSpeed(lastTimeStamp, currentTimeStamp)
	if currentTimeStamp == 0 then return 0 end
	return math.abs(lastTimeStamp - currentTimeStamp)
end

local function getAnimation(animationId)
	local animationObject
	local success, errorMsg = pcall(function()
		animationObject = game:GetObjects(animationId)[1]
	end)
	if not success then
		return nil
	end
	return animationObject
end

local Main = {}
Main.__index = Main

function Main.LoadDummy(DummyChar)
	local metatable = {}
	setmetatable(metatable, Main)
	metatable.char = DummyChar
	return metatable
end

function Main:LoadAnimation(animationId)
	local Character = self.char
	local animationObject = getAnimation(animationId)
	if not animationObject then return end
	local metatable = {}
	setmetatable(metatable, Main)
	metatable.char = Character
	metatable.animObject = animationObject
	return metatable
end

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

Player.Character.Archivable = true

scripts.title: F9 Consola
scripts.features:
F9 Beta v1.0 — Consola Lua para ejecutar código y depurar errores.

Funciones:
• Ejecuta código Lua escrito en la consola.
• Muestra errores de sintaxis y de ejecución con número de línea exacto.
• Resalta la línea del error directamente en el código mostrado.
• Captura y muestra logs del juego (print, warn, error) en tiempo real.
• Filtra logs irrelevantes del sistema (animaciones, sonidos, HTTP, etc.).
• Historial de comandos con flechas ↑ / ↓.
• Atajo F9 para abrir y cerrar la ventana.
• Ventana arrastrable y redimensionable.
• Temas claro y oscuro.

Uso:
1. Ejecuta el script.
2. Presiona F9 para abrir la consola.
3. Escribe código Lua y presiona Enter para ejecutarlo.
4. Los errores se muestran con línea y resaltado.

Versión: 1.0 Beta
Autor: Bladex hub
Reportes y mejoras: https://discord.gg/hAzTjDuhPR

scripts.features:
--[[
  DELTA FLY
  Hecho para Delta Executor (Android y PC).
  Ejecuta una vez. El panel aparece abajo a la derecha y se puede arrastrar.

  VOLAR ........... boton VOLAR o tecla F
  Mover ........... joystick o WASD (sigue la camara, incluyendo arriba/abajo)
  Subir ........... SUBIR / Espacio / E
  Bajar ........... BAJAR / Shift / Q
  Velocidad ....... + / −  en el panel
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local SPEED = 350
local MIN_SPEED, MAX_SPEED = 10, 400
local GUI_NAME = "DeltaFlyPanel"

local flying = false
local upHeld, downHeld = false, false
local bv, bg, loop, controlModule
local flyBtn, speedLabel

local function host()
	local ok, h = pcall(function()
		return gethui()
	end)
	if ok and h then
		return h
	end
	local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
	local allowed = pcall(function()
		local f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = "DF_Probe"
		f.Parent = cg
		f:Destroy()
	end)
	if allowed then
		return cg
	end
	return LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

pcall(function()
	local old = host():FindFirstChild(GUI_NAME)
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	pcall(function()
		local ps = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts", 8)
		if not ps then
			return
		end
		local pm = ps:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule") or ps:WaitForChild("PlayerModule", 8)
		if not pm then
			return
		end
		local cm = pm:FindFirstChild("ControlModule") or pm:WaitForChild("ControlModule", 5)
		if cm then
			controlModule = require(cm)
		end
	end)
end)

local function parts()
	local c = LP.Character
	if not c then
		return nil, nil
	end
	return c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function cleanupMovers()
	if loop then
		loop:Disconnect()
		loop = nil
	end
	if bv then
		bv:Destroy()
		bv = nil
	end
	if bg then
		bg:Destroy()
		bg = nil
	end
	local _, hum = parts()
	if hum then
		hum.PlatformStand = false
	end
end

local function moveVector()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then
		return Vector3.zero
	end
	local cf = cam.CFrame
	local v = Vector3.zero

	if controlModule then
		local ok, mv = pcall(function()
			return controlModule:GetMoveVector()
		end)
		if ok and typeof(mv) == "Vector3" then
			v = v + (cf.LookVector * -mv.Z) + (cf.RightVector * mv.X)
		end
	end

	if v.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
			v = v + cf.LookVector
		end
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
			v = v - cf.LookVector
		end
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
			v = v - cf.RightVector
		end
		if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
			v = v + cf.RightVector
		end
		local _, hum = parts()
		if hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 and v.Magnitude < 0.05 then
			v = v + cf.LookVector * hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude
		end
	end

	if upHeld or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) then
		v = v + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	end
	if downHeld or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then
		v = v + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
	end
	return v
end

local function startFly()
	local hrp, hum = parts()
	if not hrp or not hum then
		return
	end
	cleanupMovers()
	flying = true
	hum.Sit = false
	hum.PlatformStand = true

	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.Name = "DF_Gyro"
	bg.P = 9e4
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
	bg.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
	bg.Parent = hrp

	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

local function startFly()
	local hrp, hum = parts()
	if not hrp or not hum then

end

local function paintFly()
	if not flyBtn then

	end
	paintFly()

	btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			setHeld(false)
		end
	end)

header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y
		)
	end
end)

-- FUNÇÃO: atualizar tamanho do círculo
--============================================================

    CirculoFOV.Size = UDim2.new(0, FOVRaio * 2, 0, FOVRaio * 2)
end

--============================================================
-- FUNÇÃO: alternar estado do Aimbot (visual do botão)
--============================================================
local function AtualizarVisualBotao()
    if AimbotAtivo then
        TweenService:Create(BotaoAimbot, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 90, 70),
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(Indicador, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 140),
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 30, 20),
        }):Play()
        Indicador.Text = "ON"
        CirculoFOV.Visible = true
    else
        TweenService:Create(BotaoAimbot, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 50),
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(Indicador, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 80),
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210),
        }):Play()
        Indicador.Text = "OFF"
        CirculoFOV.Visible = false
        AlvoAtual = nil
    end
end

--============================================================
-- CLIQUE NO BOTÃO AIMBOT
--============================================================
BotaoAimbot.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    AimbotAtivo = not AimbotAtivo
    AtualizarVisualBotao()
end)

-- Efeito de hover no botão
BotaoAimbot.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    if not AimbotAtivo then
        TweenService:Create(BotaoAimbot, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65),
        }):Play()
    end
end)
BotaoAimbot.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    if not AimbotAtivo then
        TweenService:Create(BotaoAimbot, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 50),
        }):Play()
    end
end)

--============================================================
-- TEXTBOX: atualizar FOV em tempo real
--============================================================

    local Numero = tonumber(TextBoxFOV.Text)
    if Numero and Numero > 0 and Numero <= 1000 then
        FOVRaio = Numero
        AtualizarFOV()
        TextBoxStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 90)
    else
        -- Feedback visual de erro
        TextBoxStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
    end
end)

--============================================================
-- LÓGICA DO AIMBOT
--============================================================
-- Retorna o jogador mais próximo dentro do FOV
local function ObterAlvo()
    local MaisProximo = nil
    local MenorDistancia = FOVRaio
    local CentroTela = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)

    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer and Player.Character then
            local Head = Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local Humanoid = Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if Head and Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                -- Projeta posição da cabeça na tela
                local PosTela, NaTela = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)
                if NaTela then
                    -- Verifica se está do lado certo da câmera
                    local Direcao = (Head.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Unit
                    local Facing = Camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(Direcao)
                    if Facing > 0 then
                        local Dist = (Vector2.new(PosTela.X, PosTela.Y) - CentroTela).Magnitude
                        if Dist < MenorDistancia then
                            MenorDistancia = Dist
                            MaisProximo = Head
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return MaisProximo
end

-- Loop de atualização da câmera (prioridade alta)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not AimbotAtivo then return end

    local Alvo = ObterAlvo()
    if Alvo then
        AlvoAtual = Alvo
        -- Suaviza a câmera mirando na cabeça
        local PosAlvo = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, Alvo.Position)
        Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(PosAlvo, VelocidadeCam)
    else
        AlvoAtual = nil
    end
end)

--============================================================
-- ATUALIZAÇÃO INICIAL
--============================================================
AtualizarFOV()
AtualizarVisualBotao()

print("[Rayu Hub] Carregado com sucesso ✔")

local function isEnemy(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return false end
    if LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team then
        if LocalPlayer.Team == player.Team then
            return false
        end
    end
    if player.TeamColor == LocalPlayer.TeamColor and LocalPlayer.TeamColor ~= BrickColor.new("White") then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function getNearestEnemy()
    local nearestTarget = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge
    local myCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
    
    if not myCharacter or not myCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end
    local myRoot = myCharacter.HumanoidRootPart

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isEnemy(player) then
            local character = player.Character
            if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                if character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local distance = (myRoot.Position - character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance < shortestDistance then
                        shortestDistance = distance
                        nearestTarget = character
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nearestTarget
end

local function hasBomb(character)
    local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if tool then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local timePassed = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not autoEnabled then return end
    
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character.HumanoidRootPart
    
    if hasBomb(character) then
        local enemyChar = getNearestEnemy()
        if enemyChar and enemyChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and enemyChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            local enemyRoot = enemyChar.HumanoidRootPart
            local enemyHumanoid = enemyChar.Humanoid
            
            humanoid:MoveTo(enemyRoot.Position)
            
            if enemyHumanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                humanoid.Jump = true
            end
            
            timePassed = timePassed + (dt * 4)
            local offsetAngle = math.sin(timePassed) * 0.9
            
            local lookAtTarget = CFrame.new(rootPart.Position, enemyRoot.Position)
            local rotatedCFrame = lookAtTarget * CFrame.Angles(0, offsetAngle, 0)
            rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame:Lerp(rotatedCFrame, dt * 8)
            
            local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if tool then
                if tool.Parent == LocalPlayer.Backpack then
                    humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
                end
                pcall(function()
                    tool:Activate()
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end)

scripts.features:
# RatLock v24

**RatLock v24** is an all-in-one Roblox gameplay modification and visualization suite focused on targeting assistance, trigger automation, player awareness, movement utilities, weapon-aware behavior, and extensive customization.

The system is designed around a modular architecture with configurable settings, runtime state management, visibility caching, weapon profiles, visual overlays, and cleanup handling.

## 🎯 Aim Assistance

### Smart Target Selection

* Automatically scans eligible players for potential targets.
* Supports configurable target priorities.
* Uses distance and visibility checks when selecting targets.
* Supports multiple targeting body parts.
* Includes a **Hybrid** targeting mode for dynamic target-part selection.
* Uses configurable FOV-based target filtering.
* Supports configurable target range limits.
* Handles target switching with distance-aware logic.

### Target Parts

Supported target-part selection includes:

* Head
* Torso / Upper body
* Other supported character parts
* Hybrid selection

### Dynamic Sensitivity

* Adjustable base sensitivity.
* Dynamic sensitivity scaling based on target distance.
* Separate close-range behavior.
* Configurable close-range boost.
* Configurable very-close-range boost.
* Customizable distance thresholds.

### FOV Control

* Configurable FOV radius.
* FOV-based target filtering.
* Runtime FOV adjustment through the public API.
* Automatic validation and clamping of FOV values.

### Prediction

* Optional target movement prediction.
* Configurable bullet-speed based prediction.
* Bullet-speed validation prevents invalid values from entering the system.

### Camera / Visibility Handling

* Visibility checks use Roblox raycasting.
* Local character exclusion is handled through raycast parameters.
* Visibility results are cached to reduce repeated calculations.
* Visibility cache considers:

  * Target position
  * Target character reference
  * Camera position
  * Cache age
* Cached results automatically expire.

---

# 🔫 Trigger System

## Triggerbot

* Automatically detects when a valid target is under the crosshair.
* Supports configurable trigger range and FOV conditions.
* Performs visibility checks before triggering.
* Integrates with weapon-specific trigger profiles.
* Supports optional hold behavior.
* Automatically releases when trigger conditions are no longer valid.

## Weapon-Aware Trigger Profiles

RatLock supports different trigger configurations for different weapon types.

Profiles can contain behavior such as:

* Trigger delay
* Burst count
* Burst timing
* Hold behavior
* Weapon-specific trigger settings

The system can automatically detect the currently equipped weapon and select the corresponding profile.

## Weapon Detection

* Detects weapon changes during runtime.
* Uses deterministic weapon matching.
* Supports configurable weapon ordering.
* Polls the equipped weapon state periodically.
* Automatically updates the active trigger profile after a weapon switch.

## Weapon Switch Handling

When the equipped weapon changes, RatLock can:

* Release an active trigger state.
* Reset burst state.
* Reset reaction timing.
* Reset target acquisition state.
* Reset shot timing.
* Apply the new weapon profile.

## Reaction Delay

* Optional reaction delay before triggering.
* Tracks when a target was first detected.
* Uses target acquisition timing as part of trigger behavior.
